item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya switches on the electric room heater at her home in Jaipur. After a few minutes, the nichrome coil inside the heater becomes warm and glows.
Why does the nichrome coil become warm when the heater is switched on?

options.A: The coil becomes warm simply because the switch is connected to the mains supply.
options.B: Current flows through the coil, the resistance of nichrome opposes the current, and heat is produced.
options.C: The coil becomes warm first, and its warmth then makes the electric current flow.
options.D: Only nichrome wires become warm; the current passes through them without any resistance.
